segments.name: Agency RMBS
segments.description: Invests in Agency RMBS to earn net interest margin and interest income, paying monthly distributions to stockholders.
segments.evidence: Consequently, the Company has determined that it operates in a single reportable segment and the strategic purpose of all operating activities is to support that one segment.

revenueModel.text: Nearly all income is interest earned on its RMBS portfolio of mortgage-backed securities.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives nearly all of its income from interest on its RMBS portfolio.
